expected_root_cause: NewClient creates pools and then performs later initialization that can panic. Without a deferred cleanup path, a panic before the client is returned leaves those pools and their connections alive with no caller reference available to close them.
fix_summary: Defer cleanup for a partially built client until construction succeeds, preserving the original panic while closing pools and background resources on failure.
curation_notes: PR #4003 adds a panic cleanup defer in NewClient and a custom dialer regression test that checks every opened connection is eventually closed.
